title: Barnaby's Park Party
markdown:
Teacher May smiled. "Good morning, everyone! Barnaby Goose has a special announcement!"

Otis the otter stopped juggling pebbles, and Sunny the puppy looked up from a butterfly.

Barnaby Goose puffed out his chest. "Friends! We're having a meeting to make our park even more fun!"

Otis asked, "When is it, Barnaby?"

Barnaby tilted his head. "When the sun is highest, and it's the first day of the week!"

"That's noon on Monday!" Teacher May said.

Barnaby nodded. "Yes! We'll ask what games you love! Maybe a bouncy slide or a splash-ball pond!"

"Splash-ball!" Sunny yipped, doing a happy dance.

Otis wiggled. "Wonderful ideas, Barnaby!"

Barnaby beamed. "Hooray for the park!"

Everyone smiled, excited for the meeting. Making things better together was a very happy thing.
characters: Otis the otter, Sunny the puppy, Teacher May
